declarations.name: PROJECT_BRAIN_SCHEMA_VERSION
declarations.doc: Initial Project Brain contract schema version (v0.3 Phase 0).

declarations.name: ProjectIdentityKind
declarations.doc: How a ProjectIdentity was resolved: an explicit configured id or a deterministic derived id.

declarations.name: ProjectIdentity
declarations.doc: Deterministic, network-free identity for a project across runs. Stores no raw absolute path and no secret.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Opaque, stable identity key for all Project Brain storage.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: Whether the id is explicit (configured) or derived (deterministic from a normalized, salted root token).

fields.name: schemaVersion
fields.doc: Project Brain schema version for this contract.

fields.name: displayName
fields.doc: Human-readable project name for output only.

fields.name: rootHint
fields.doc: Display-only, non-absolute root token; never the raw absolute path.

declarations.name: EvidenceSourceKind
declarations.doc: Source taxonomy for an evidence record, matching the existing provider source kinds.

declarations.name: RawContentPolicy
declarations.doc: How much observed content an evidence record retains. Default is minimized; verbatim text is opt-in only.

declarations.name: RetentionState
declarations.doc: Lifecycle state of an evidence record in the ledger.

declarations.name: EvidenceRecord
declarations.doc: A minimized, sanitized record of one observed source item. Never stores credentials, raw provider responses, or GitHub bodies.

fields.name: evidenceId
fields.doc: Stable id for this evidence record.

fields.name: projectId
fields.doc: Owning ProjectIdentity id.

fields.name: sourceKind
fields.doc: Kind of source this record was observed from.

fields.name: sourceIdentity
fields.doc: Sanitized source reference (document-relative path + line/range, or item number). Never an absolute path, never a token.

fields.name: observedAt
fields.doc: Caller-injected observation timestamp; never read from a system clock.

fields.name: provenance
fields.doc: Allow-listed structured provenance only (line/range or item provenance). No bodies, tokens, or commit identifiers.

fields.name: rawContentPolicy
fields.doc: Whether and how observed content is retained for this record.

fields.name: retentionState
fields.doc: Lifecycle state of this record.

fields.name: schemaVersion
fields.doc: Project Brain schema version for this contract.

fields.name: contentFingerprint
fields.doc: Hash of the minimized observed text, enabling change detection without storing text verbatim. Omitted for notStored evidence.

fields.name: sourceUpdatedAt
fields.doc: Source-reported update time where available (e.g. GitHub updatedAt).

fields.name: metadata
fields.doc: Allow-listed classification fields only (severity, status, labels-as-classification). Never raw bodies.

declarations.name: FreshnessStatus
declarations.doc: Whether a freshness dimension has a known age or is explicitly unknown.

declarations.name: FreshnessDimension
declarations.doc: One separately tracked freshness dimension. Allows an explicit unknown state without guessing a timestamp.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Whether this dimension's age is known or explicitly unknown.

fields.name: ageSeconds
fields.doc: Age in seconds relative to the injected reference time, when known.

fields.name: referenceTimestamp
fields.doc: Caller-injected reference time this age was measured against, when known.

declarations.name: Freshness
declarations.doc: The separated freshness and coverage model. Four independent dimensions, never collapsed into one score and never a learned or probabilistic value.

fields.name: observationFreshness
fields.doc: How long ago this observation was captured.

fields.name: sourceFreshness
fields.doc: How recently the source reported an update.

fields.name: evidenceFreshness
fields.doc: How recently the contributing evidence content last changed.

fields.name: derivedStateFreshness
fields.doc: How current the derived state is relative to its evidence.

fields.name: coverageComplete
fields.doc: Whether all intended sources were observed with no gaps.

fields.name: coverageGaps
fields.doc: Explicit descriptors of sources or scopes that were not observed.

fields.name: schemaVersion
fields.doc: Project Brain schema version for this contract.

declarations.name: StateItemKind
declarations.doc: Kind of canonical state item in a ProjectState.

declarations.name: CanonicalStateItem
declarations.doc: A generic, provider-independent state item. Carries title-level structured fields and evidence references only; never raw content.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: The kind of item.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Stable item id from the existing dedup keys (candidate id, doc-id + normalized title, or source id).

fields.name: title
fields.doc: Title-level text only.

fields.name: evidenceRefs
fields.doc: Evidence record ids backing this item.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Normalized status label, when applicable.

fields.name: severity
fields.doc: Normalized severity label, when applicable.

fields.name: owner
fields.doc: Normalized owner handle from an explicit source field only.

fields.name: dueDate
fields.doc: Timezone-safe due date, when applicable.

fields.name: priority
fields.doc: Normalized priority label, when applicable.

fields.name: metadata
fields.doc: Allow-listed sanitized classification fields only.

declarations.name: SourceDescriptor
declarations.doc: Sanitized descriptor of one observed source. No tokens, no raw bodies, no absolute paths.

fields.name: sourceKind
fields.doc: Kind of source.

fields.name: sourceIdentity
fields.doc: Sanitized source reference key; never an absolute path.

declarations.name: ProjectState
declarations.doc: The canonical, provider-independent derived state at one observation. Never raw provider output and never generated prose as the sole representation.

fields.name: identity
fields.doc: The resolved project identity.

fields.name: observedAt
fields.doc: Caller-injected observation timestamp; never read from a system clock.

fields.name: sources
fields.doc: Sanitized descriptors of the observed sources.

fields.name: statusSummary
fields.doc: Deterministic status counts (not content).

fields.name: evidenceRefs
fields.doc: Evidence record ids backing this state, so the state can be rebuilt from the ledger.

fields.name: freshness
fields.doc: The separated freshness and coverage model for this state.

fields.name: schemaVersion
fields.doc: Project Brain schema version for this contract.

fields.name: stateFingerprint
fields.doc: Deterministic hash over the canonicalized state. A string field only in Phase 0; no calculation is implemented here.

fields.name: objective
fields.doc: Title-level objective, when present.

fields.name: milestones
fields.doc: Milestone items.

fields.name: tasks
fields.doc: Task items.

fields.name: risks
fields.doc: Risk items.

fields.name: decisions
fields.doc: Decision items.

fields.name: dependencies
fields.doc: Dependency items.

fields.name: blockers
fields.doc: Blocker items (high-severity risk subset).

declarations.name: CoverageState
declarations.doc: Whether a snapshot source boundary fully observed its scope, was partial, or was skipped.

declarations.name: SourceBoundary
declarations.doc: Descriptor making a snapshot's partial observation explicit for one source. No absolute paths, no raw content.

fields.name: sourceIdentity
fields.doc: Sanitized source reference key; never an absolute path.

fields.name: includedScope
fields.doc: Which scope of the source was in scope for this capture.

fields.name: coverageState
fields.doc: Whether this source was fully, partially, or not observed.

fields.name: gapReason
fields.doc: Sanitized reason a source was partial or skipped, when applicable.

declarations.name: ProjectSnapshot
declarations.doc: An immutable capture: identity + state + evidence refs + boundaries + a deterministic fingerprint. Models data only; no write or persistence behavior in Phase 0.

fields.name: snapshotId
fields.doc: Stable snapshot id.

fields.name: projectId
fields.doc: Owning ProjectIdentity id.

fields.name: capturedAt
fields.doc: Caller-injected capture timestamp; never read from a system clock.

fields.name: sourceBoundaries
fields.doc: Which sources and scopes were in scope, making partial observations explicit.

fields.name: state
fields.doc: The canonical ProjectState frozen by this snapshot.

fields.name: evidenceRefs
fields.doc: Evidence record ids this snapshot froze; ids only.

fields.name: schemaVersion
fields.doc: Project Brain schema version for this contract.

fields.name: fingerprint
fields.doc: Deterministic hash over state fingerprint, sorted evidence ids, and boundaries. A string field only in Phase 0; no calculation is implemented here.

declarations.name: ChangeCategory
declarations.doc: Deterministic change category for a single item between two snapshots. Exact/normalized matching only; no fuzzy confidence.

declarations.name: StateChange
declarations.doc: One deterministic change to a single item. Carries structured previous/current values only; no fuzzy score, no LLM explanation, no raw body.

fields.name: category
fields.doc: The change category.

fields.name: itemKind
fields.doc: The kind of item that changed.

fields.name: itemId
fields.doc: Stable item id, using the existing exact/normalized identifiers only.

fields.name: evidenceRefs
fields.doc: Evidence record ids supporting this change.

fields.name: previousValue
fields.doc: The item's previous structured value, when relevant.

fields.name: currentValue
fields.doc: The item's current structured value, when relevant.

declarations.name: ChangeSet
declarations.doc: The deterministic diff between two snapshots. Rule-based, exact/normalized matching only; the same two snapshots produce deep-equal changes.

fields.name: projectId
fields.doc: Owning ProjectIdentity id.

fields.name: previousSnapshotId
fields.doc: Id of the previous snapshot in the comparison.

fields.name: currentSnapshotId
fields.doc: Id of the current snapshot in the comparison.

fields.name: comparedAt
fields.doc: Caller-injected comparison timestamp or boundary; never read from a system clock.

fields.name: changes
fields.doc: Ordered, deterministic changes.

fields.name: schemaVersion
fields.doc: Project Brain schema version for this contract.

declarations.name: TimelineEvent
declarations.doc: One sanitized change to one subject, attributed to the capture that first observed it (v0.4). Derived from adjacent committed snapshots; never persisted. Carries allow-listed, title-level fields only: no raw evidence, no evidence ids, no unrestricted previous/current values, no paths.

fields.name: eventId
fields.doc: Deterministic id derived from canonical, domain-separated event inputs. The same inputs always produce the same id.

fields.name: projectId
fields.doc: Owning ProjectIdentity id.

fields.name: snapshotId
fields.doc: Id of the current snapshot of the adjacent pair that produced this event.

fields.name: captureSequence
fields.doc: That snapshot's contiguous 1-based capture ordinal from the authoritative chronology. The primary sort key; never a lexical id order.

fields.name: eventSequence
fields.doc: The event's 0-based ordinal within its capture, in deterministic change order. The secondary sort key.

fields.name: capturedAt
fields.doc: That snapshot's authoritative capture timestamp. Presentation data only; never a sort key.

fields.name: category
fields.doc: The existing deterministic change category.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: The existing kind of item that changed.

fields.name: subjectId
fields.doc: The changed item's stable id, using the existing exact/normalized identifiers only.

fields.name: evidenceCount
fields.doc: How many evidence records back this change. A count only; never evidence ids.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: Title-level text only, when present.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Normalized status label, when present.

fields.name: severity
fields.doc: Normalized severity label, when present.

fields.name: dueDate
fields.doc: Timezone-safe due date, when present.

declarations.name: TimelineQuery
declarations.doc: A bounded, read-only timeline request (v0.4). Carries no path, no data directory, no token, and no capture, apply, migrate, or write field: a timeline query cannot mutate anything.

fields.name: projectId
fields.doc: Required owning ProjectIdentity id.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc: Maximum events returned (1..100, default 20). Applied after filtering.

fields.name: beforeSequence
fields.doc: Exclusive upper bound on captureSequence for pagination: only events with a strictly lower capture sequence are eligible. Non-negative.

fields.name: category
fields.doc: Optional change-category filter, from the existing taxonomy.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: Optional item-kind filter, from the existing taxonomy.

declarations.name: TimelineResult
declarations.doc: The bounded, newest-first result of one timeline query (v0.4). The event array is bounded by the validated limit; hasMore and nextBeforeSequence are stable and truthful.

fields.name: projectId
fields.doc: Owning ProjectIdentity id, echoed from the query.

fields.name: eventCount
fields.doc: Number of events in this page (equals events.length).

fields.name: hasMore
fields.doc: True exactly when at least one eligible event remains below this page.

fields.name: events
fields.doc: The page of events, newest capture first, then ascending eventSequence within each capture.

fields.name: nextBeforeSequence
fields.doc: The beforeSequence value that returns the next page with no duplicate and no skip. Present exactly when hasMore is true.
